node_definition.done_when: tests/test_a_session_mismatch_never_skips_the_host_silently.py runs a dispatch hand-off on a temporary crew home with a stand-in waiting host. A --session name that differs from the calling session writes the request to the caller's host FIFO, prints the naming line, and returns host_handoff with both session names and handed_to_host true. With no waiting host, handed_to_host is false and the line says so. A matching session writes the request as before. Negative control: at the base revision the mismatched case writes nothing and prints nothing. The test files importing reckon.crew.dispatch_watch add no failure against base in matched arms run as an all_debug partition job, submitted with env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch and never on the fleet node. Each arm's log sits under the run directory, opens with its revision and literal command, and ends in EXIT=. ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the staged paths.
